events.verdict: Allen (BKN) makes marginal contact with Collison (IND) while disengaging from the pick.
Collison (IND) trips Dudley (BKN) during his drive.
RLB shows Turner (IND) clamps Allen's (BKN) arm and affects his ability to get the rebound.
Kurucs (BKN) and Oladipo (IND) briefly engage and separate while going for the loose ball.
Dudley (BKN) is still moving into Oladipo's (IND) path while setting the screen and does not give him room to avoid the contact.
Dudley (BKN) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Bogdanovic's (IND) hand after he has released the ball.
Collison (IND) wraps Allen (BKN) after the pick and affects his FOM.
Allen (BKN) sets the screen on Collison (IND) and gives him room to avoid contact.
Turner (IND) maintains a legal guarding position on Dinwiddie's (BKN) drive to the basket and makes incidental contact with his hand that is considered part of the ball.
All technical fouls are reviewed by League Operations.
Kurucs (BKN) jumps A to B into Collison (IND) and makes contact that affects his driving shot attempt.
Allen (BKN) sets the screen on Collison (IND) and does not deliver contact.
Young (IND) makes contact with Kurucs (BKN) that affects his SQBR.
Allen (BKN) makes marginal contact with Turner (IND) and does not affect his SQBR.
Harris (BKN) is in the paint without actively guarding an opponent for longer than three seconds.
Dinwiddie (BKN) makes marginal contact with Oladipo (IND) during the hand-off and does not affect his ability to receive the ball.
Dinwiddie (BKN) makes marginal contact with Oladipo's (IND) arm after he releases the jump shot attempt that does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
